findings.subject: NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp
findings.message: File timestamp API (NSFileModificationDate, modificationDate) is called 2 times in 2 files, first here, and no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp
findings.fix: Add an NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes entry for NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp with the reason that matches the use. Apple lists: DDA9.1, C617.1, 3B52.1, 0A2A.1

findings.subject: NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeEmailAddress
findings.fix: Give every collected data type its Linked and Tracking booleans and at least one purpose

findings.subject: NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace
findings.message: Disk space (NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace) is declared, and no scanned code calls it
findings.fix: Remove the entry if no code or linked SDK in this target calls the API; keep it if the call is in code this scan does not read (a precompiled library, another language)

notes: left out 1 kind of folder (Pods); use --include-deps to read them
